answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network enforces quadratic stake burning per identity: creating n nodes requires an ivory certificate deposit costing O(n^2), causing attacker friction to scale superlinearly. During registration, cryptographic stake is burned in an irreversible plume, verifiable across the ledger. This economic gravity turns any coordinated Sybil swarm into an unsustainable nebula of exponentially escalating capital destruction.
